name: Image-Based Volume Rendering
aliases: Image Based Rendering Assisted Volume Rendering
Image-Based Volume Rendering (IBVR) with Opacity Light Fields
definition: An image-based approach to volume rendering that renders arbitrarily large datasets interactively on current graphics hardware by separating volume rendering (preprocessing) from volume viewing (interactive). It allows exploration of interior structure via clipping surfaces without volumetric re-rendering.
summary: Image-Based Volume Rendering accelerates large dataset exploration by precomputing ray slices as opacity light fields, enabling unrestricted viewpoints and dynamic clipping without re-rendering.
